title: What Really Happened During the Texas Power Grid Outage?
summary: Practical Engineering's explanation of the February 2021 Texas winter storm and the resulting power grid outage. It lays out the facts about ERCOT, the grid's isolation, and how generation across fuel types failed in the cold.
why: Whenever Texas grid failures come up, HN people link it as the calm, technically informed account that cuts through political blame.
